glossary.warmup: A lighter set to get ready. Stop well before it gets hard.
glossary.mainset: Your one all-out set. Go until you can't do another clean rep.
glossary.failure: The point where you can't do another clean rep.
glossary.cleanrep: A full rep with good form and no help.
glossary.percent: A share of your main-set weight. The main set is 100%.
glossary.topset: Your heaviest set of the day.
glossary.backoff: Lighter sets done straight after your heaviest set.
glossary.repsleft: How many more clean reps you could still have done.
glossary.pair: Do the two exercises back to back. Then rest.
glossary.restpause: A short pause in the middle of a set, then a few more reps.
glossary.forced: Extra reps a partner helps you finish.
glossary.short: You stopped before you couldn't do another rep.
glossary.plates: How many plates you pin on a machine's weight stack.
glossary.weekab: Week A and Week B: the two weeks of a powerbuilding block. Week B is a bit harder.
glossary.block: A run of weeks on one plan, two by default. Then you swap to the other plan. Change it in the calendar on the Plans page.
glossary.estmax: A rough guess at the most you could lift for one rep.
glossary.target: What to aim for today, worked out from last time.
glossary.swap: Do a different exercise when yours isn't possible today.
glossary.variation: Another version of the same exercise, like a rope instead of a bar.
glossary.shy: Stop that many clean reps before you can't do another.
glossary.makeup: An exercise from a missed day, done on a later day.
glossary.topsetfinder: Work up in small jumps to find today's heaviest set of 5.
glossary.carryeffort: For carries, the same 0 to 4 numbers judge grip and posture, not bar speed. 4 is easy, 0 means you had to put it down.
glossary.weekbase: Your result on the same exercise earlier this week. When the later session is Legs B, its target starts from this result, so you hold the same weight and reps on a less-rested day.
glossary.extra: An exercise you add yourself, like a burnout set at the end. It doesn't change the plan.
glossary.regularswap: Do the swap every week on this day until you turn it off. It gets its own targets.
glossary.hold: Holds like a plank: log the seconds you held and any weight added. Carries: log the metres walked and the weight. Next time, aim 5 seconds longer, or the same distance.
